title: Why Do We Celebrate Birthdays?
hook: A birthday marks one more trip around the sun.
narration: A birthday marks one more trip around the sun.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do We Celebrate Birthdays.
We pause to say you matter.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Cake is optional. Kindness is not.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Another year of you is worth noticing.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: A birthday marks one more trip around the sun.
The pictures today are a new heart world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do we celebrate birthdays.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
